data.sender_name: Kreis Nordmuster – Der Landrat, Fachdienst Naturschutz

items.title: Last day to file Widerspruch against the refusal of the exemption for the boat jetty
items.quote: Möchten Sie die Entscheidung anfechten, erheben Sie Widerspruch – innerhalb eines Monats, gerechnet ab der Bekanntgabe, schriftlich, elektronisch mit qualifizierter Signatur oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Nordmuster, Kreishaus, Marktstraße 1, 25813 Musterwik.
items.computation: Letter dated Monday 01.09.2025; the posting date is assumed to be the letter date. The letter states that a posted decision counts as announced on the fourth day after posting, so Bekanntgabe is 05.09.2025 (Friday). The one-month period (§ 187 Abs. 1, § 188 Abs. 2 BGB) starts the next day, 06.09.2025, and would end on 05.10.2025. That is a Sunday, so under § 193 BGB the period ends on Monday 06.10.2025. If a three-day rule applied instead, Bekanntgabe would be 04.09.2025 and the month would end on Saturday 04.10.2025, which moves to Monday 06.10.2025. The result is the same either way.

warnings: The deadline assumes the letter was posted on 01.09.2025; if it was posted later, the deadline moves later, so keep the envelope or postmark and file early.

The two dates given for today conflict (2025-09-05 in the request, 2026-09-30 in the environment). I used 2025-09-05, so the deadline of 2025-10-06 is still open. If today is really 2026-09-30, the deadline has already passed.
The Widerspruch must reach the Kreis in writing, by qualified electronic signature or as a record taken at the office. A plain email is not enough.
